name: Director Manager Total
storyline:
Welcome, Chaos Manager (brace yourself)!

Hop in a time-machine, or don’t. Past, future, or straight back to 1993, it’s all the same here. In DMT: Director Manager Total you don’t need time-travel excuses; the only fact that matters is your club is a glorious mess and you’re its last, best hope.

Recruit world-beaters! Sack the deadwood! Dream up delightfully ridiculous formations! Spruce up that “stadium” (right now it’s basically a vacant lot). Run training drills for the lads, or at least look busy while they pretend to run them.

Bottom line:
It’s not the most realistic football sim.
It’s the most fun one.
summary: Director Manager Total is a football management sim: wheel and deal in the transfer market, craft daring tactics, and drag a ramshackle club to league glory.
